design_picks.hero_archetype_reason: Step by Step's wedge is the modern home as visual asset. None of the 5 references lead with the actual residence; making the house the protagonist is the primary differentiator.
design_picks.section_sequence_reason: Lead with the residence (the wedge), follow with five-pillar Method (philosophy section every premium reference has), then founder (Yomi's story is the trust anchor), then differentiators with embedded testimonials, then a discrete investor teaser linking to /partner, then inquiry, then FAQ teaser, then footer.
design_picks.photo_direction_reason: Real photography of the modern St. Louis home — golden-hour exterior, naturally-lit interiors, single-bedroom hotel-quality bedding, communal kitchen/dining. No stock recovery imagery.
design_picks.animation_reason: Recovery niche allowlist + minimum-viable motion. Nothing dramatic. Vestibular-sensitive audience may include trauma history. Honors prefers-reduced-motion.
